description: §19.9.1 / §19.9.4 (RUNTIME, real server bundle) — a SERVER-side `fail .Rejected(503, "queue full")` of a TWO-field variant reaches the CLIENT `!{ | ::Rejected(code, reason) :> … }` arm with both bindings resolved by field name. Pre-fix (s441 D2) the server pass had no variant field schema, so it keyed the payload positionally (`data: { _0: 503, _1: "queue full" }`) while the client arm read `data.code` / `data.reason`, so @msg was "undefined (undefined)".
rationale: §19.9.1: the wire envelope's `.data` is the field-keyed payload `{ ... }`, identical on both sides; §19.9.4 makes the serialization boundary transparent. Multi-field companion of error/server-fail-single-field-payload-rt: the same null server-pass schema broke both shapes (raw value for one field, `_0`/`_1` keys for several). `serverDb` runs the REAL emitted server bundle.
